_comment: Logo/wordmark register. Every mark below ships as a true <path>-based SVG (assets/img/logos/*.svg), generated from the client's PNG originals in source/logos/ by tools/trace-logos.mjs — see that file's header comment and HANDOVER.md §7 for how each is produced (four are auto-traced with imagetracerjs; Gallery Cosmos's radial-gradient mark is reconstructed as real SVG gradient geometry instead, since a flat-colour tracer can only posterize a gradient into bands). The original high-resolution transparent WebP versions (*-01.webp) are kept alongside as an alternate-format asset — nothing on the live site references them any more.

marks.label: Gallery Cosmos
marks.format: svg (radial-gradient mark, hand-built geometry + traced text — see tools/trace-logos.mjs buildGalleryCosmos())

marks.label: Cosmos Group
marks.note: OUTSTANDING ASSET REQUEST — not available locally. Only seen live at cosmosgroup.com.bd (e.g. logo-white.png, cg-logo-v4-white.png); those are not ours to ship, so nothing was hotlinked or downloaded from that site. Nav renders a same-sized placeholder box (.brand__cg-mark in layout.css) until the client supplies the real mark, ideally as vector (AI/EPS/SVG). See HANDOVER.md §6.
